notes.title: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest
notes.notes:
Great news everyone! 

We're thrilled to unveil the next chapter in the captivating journey of our beloved heroes! Brace yourselves for an unforgettable adventure as Angelo and Deemon will return in "Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest" After the unexpected delay caused by the war, we're happy to announce that the sequel development is well underway. Prepare to embark on a journey beyond imagination as our fearless duo ventures forth into Heaven itself! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2932720/Angelo_and_Deemon_2_Too_Hell_of_a_Quest

Stay tuned for future announcements.

notes.title: Meet The Wild Case
notes.notes:
Please welcome our new adventure game The Wild Case. 

This is a 2D first-person point-and-click adventure. This is a story-focused adventure where players will meet a cast of colorful characters, experience mysterious encounters, and solve puzzles to progress through the game.

Don't forget to wishlist the game if you haven't yet:)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1178230/The_Wild_Case

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Great news everyone! 
Version 1.2 is out now. 
A pile of bugs burned down in Hell's fire.
Sara's firmware updated. She is smarter now.
Text errors were hunted down and destroyed by a special killer (Mostly in Russian).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34828875/1c7c0e2a0e9d5e3eb0f6f9e64205adaa0e6f4680.png[/img]

notes.title: We want your feedback!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34828875/834937c40f5a4fce5ee87693b6d2e77a279b432f.png[/img]
Your feedback is a kind of energy we use to create games. Now with the current release, we are exhausted. Please help us. Tell what you think about the game.

It's been a long 5 years road for us.

notes.title: It's ALIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34828875/81d09cda8a1c46e27798a3774b958fdd62653b8c.png[/img]

And now it's released. We made this Hell for you to enjoy!

notes.title: Release date!
notes.notes:
Great news everyone! 

We are releasing super soon!!! Working hard to make it on time. Angelo and Deemon: One Hell of a Quest will be released on September 27th

If you haven’t already, be sure to Follow us and Wishlist. 
You can also contact us on our [url=https://discord.gg/DFMJUjE]Discord[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/SpecialbitStudio/]Facebook[/url].

Thank you for your interest and support!
